verdict.rationale: cfo.ai documents downloading a Page as an Excel workbook that keeps its formulas, which covers spreadsheet export, and it mentions Ari drafting a board deck off the latest numbers. That deck mention implies slides but never documents a slide-file export. The read-only report link is sharing rather than file export, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented PDF export, explicit slide-format (e.g. PPTX/Google Slides) export, and independent or hands-on corroboration of any export.
